subject: Startups
title: TikTok's Algorithm-Driven Virality
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: TikTok's Algorithm-Driven Virality.

hook.text: TikTok doesn't rely on who you follow. Its algorithm shows content from anyone, making overnight fame possible.

buildup.text: On Instagram, reach depends on followers. On TikTok, a new creator's video can get millions of views instantly.

discovery.text: This creates a dopamine loop for creators: post, go viral, post more. The platform rewards volume and hooks.

twist.text: Creator virality drives user acquisition. People download TikTok because they saw a video shared elsewhere.

climax.text: TikTok reached one billion users faster than any app in history. The algorithm is the growth engine.

punchline.text: When anyone can go viral, everyone keeps posting.

quiz.question: How does TikTok's growth model differ from Instagram's early model?
options: Its algorithm surfaces content regardless of follower count
